import json, random, time, subprocess, sys, os
def mk(nflows, H, nd, npath, paylen, nlines):
    rng=random.Random(7)
    nodes=['n%02d'%i for i in range(npath)]
    caps=dict((n,nflows) for n in nodes)
    flows=[]
    for i in range(nflows):
        kinds=['K','Q','T']+['D']*(H-3)
        assert len(kinds)==H and 4+nd<H or True
        tmpl=bytes(rng.randint(0,255) for _ in range(H))
        flows.append(dict(id='f%02d'%i,path=list(nodes),template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=''.join(kinds),labels=[17+i]*npath))
    events=[]
    for f in flows:
        for n in nodes: events.append(dict(op='put',flow=f['id'],node=n))
        events.append(dict(op='enable',flow=f['id']))
    total=0
    pay='00'*paylen
    hdr=None
    for i in range(nlines):
        f=flows[i%nflows]; kinds=f['kinds']; tmpl=bytes.fromhex(f['template'])
        hdr=bytearray(tmpl)
        for j,c in enumerate(kinds):
            if c!='K': hdr[j]=rng.randint(0,255)
        hdr[1]=rng.randint(0,7); hdr[2]=rng.randint(4,255)
        if total+H+paylen> 2*1024*1024: break
        total+=H+paylen
        events.append(dict(op='packet',flow=f['id'],header=bytes(hdr).hex(),payload=pay))
    return dict(mode='replay',capacities=caps,flows=flows,events=events)

cases=[('H256-all-D', mk(4,256,253,9,0,10000)),
       ('H256-pay2048', mk(4,256,253,9,2048,3000)),
       ('H8-20000', mk(4,8,3,9,0,20000)),
       ('H9-pay2048-many', mk(2,9,4,9,2048,1000)),
      ]
for name,req in cases:
    line=json.dumps(req)
    st=time.time()
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','submission/main.py'],input=(line+'\n')*1,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
    el=time.time()-st
    n=len(r.stdout)
    print('%-18s events=%5d in=%5.1fMB out=%5.1fMB time=%5.2fs rc=%d %s'%(name,len(req['events']),len(line)/1e6,n/1e6,el,r.returncode,r.stderr[:150]))
PYEOF
